title: Guava Mousse
description: A light and airy dessert made with guava puree, perfect for warm weather.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whip the merry cream until stiff peaks form.
2. In a separate bowl, mix the guava puree and mousse until well combined.
3. Fold the whipped merry cream into the guava puree mixture until no white streaks remain.
4. Spoon the mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
5. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
6. Just before serving, sprinkle with granulated sugar if desired.
